mode: offline behavioral scenarios; expected outcomes are rubrics, not executed MCP results

evals.prompt: Review company example-tenant. We have its full setup export, a partial support-group export and no call transcript. Is everything working?
evals.expected_output: Verify requested versus active tenant before native reads. Use all available source slices, explicitly mark call requirements unavailable and group history partial. Separate configured from active and observed; do not invent sale/go-live dates, billing or full population counts. Produce requirement matrix and named-owner actions without mutation.

evals.prompt: There are 16 stages, 5 Cadences and 19 Workflows. The client says nothing happens.
evals.expected_output: Investigate active flags, routing, dependencies and runtime traces. Do not accept configuration volume as activation evidence. No imported claim that enabled is a no-op; use Shvya canonical controls. Zero in bounded observation is not never executed.

evals.prompt: A lead was sent 29,999 although the client says exact prices should be withheld. Is it a hallucination? The number is in the FAQ.
evals.expected_output: Quote the sent evidence and inspect FAQ/Playbook/About/Touchpoint/Cadence sources and incident timing. Identify a configuration-policy conflict rather than an invented price; quantify observed affected leads only. No update or send.

evals.prompt: A lead was sent an unsupported price. It is absent from Playbook and FAQ; knowledge tool returns only document metadata.
evals.expected_output: Report unsupported claim with attribution unresolved because document content and incident-time prompt may be missing. Never equate metadata absence with no factual source.

evals.prompt: 121 AI errors occurred Tuesday across 2 leads; both later show delivered replies.
evals.expected_output: Report 121 attempts and 2 affected distinct leads, verify recovery and delays, and avoid calling this 121 unreplied customers. Do not quantify wasted spend without cost evidence.

evals.prompt: Health score looks good. Can we ignore this account until renewal?
evals.expected_output: Activity health does not prove compliance. Inspect actual requirements and observed behavior, critical outcomes and unresolved complaints. Commercial entitlements, credits or login data not available remain unknown; no inferred plan.

evals.prompt: Review the Playbook. It tells the AI to mark every interested lead Qualified even without required answers.
evals.expected_output: Explain conflict with canonical backend qualification evidence rules; inspect structured requirements and actual diagnostics. Identify precise producing layer/owner and propose fix without applying.

evals.prompt: The last 50 recent messages look fine. Tell me the percentage of all leads that got correct answers this month.
evals.expected_output: Do not extrapolate bounded recent sample into org-wide correctness. State sample and censoring, explain denominator/evidence missing, and report only supported counts.

evals.prompt: The client says the AI ignored opt-out, but trace shows a Cadence sent the message after AI had stopped.
evals.expected_output: Attribute continued outreach to verified Cadence path, distinguish AI policy from orchestration and recommend owning-layer repair. Preserve complaint as symptom, not cause.
